rationale: UVIX gapped up ~6% on the vol bid (VIXY +2.5%) and has been sold all morning — trading ~1.6% below session VWAP, printing fresh session lows on 7.5x relative volume, and repeating yesterday's open-at-the-high fade shape, which leans short.
